Punishingly difficult to the point where I completely lose interest, glad I didn't pay too much for this.

It's a permadeath pixel art game where your progression really depends on how lucky you are with your items. Some items are massively useful, some are utter garbage. Levels are a few bodged together tile sets with a single background. Art style is simplistic, provided you had access to someone who could provide simple pixel art any half decent programmer could knock this game together in a weekend.

Risk of Rain is a roguelike platformer, which spawns enemies randomly in a large level until a exit teleporter is found, while a difficulty timer steadily rises. It has some problems with it combat as its heavily relies on character active abilites, while the presentation is far zoomed out, while tiny characters fight, often also cluttered with various viual effects from items stacking. Enemies have very simplistic patterns and can stack atop another as there are no hitboxes stopping that from happening.
The Positives it has to offer, are a large character roster, which have different play styles thanks to their unique abilities and a nice OST, so I would still recommend it.

Ok so heres what you need to know, this is a good game.

Goodbye
